nsge01.title: Minneapolis: never going outside
nsge01.caption: Virgo found a way to cross a whole city without touching snow, and somehow also without meeting a single person. Which sign in your life packs the backup map?

nsge02.title: Montreal: the underground crush
nsge02.caption: Cancer heard 'underground city' and moved in emotionally. It took one Bonjour-hi to bring them back up. Who's the friend you have to coax out of the tunnel?

nsge03.title: Boston: the parking-spot chair
nsge03.caption: Aries thinks a lawn chair can reserve anything, including a skate date with someone they haven't met. Spoiler: you just ask. What's the pettiest thing you've ever saved a spot for?

nsge04.title: Denver: love at the summit
nsge04.caption: Sagittarius went looking for love on a mountaintop while the cozy one was waiting in town with cocoa. Tag the friend who always needs a summit.

nsge05.title: Philadelphia: mixed signals, twisted
nsge05.caption: Gemini's texts come with more twists than a soft pretzel. The fix was a plain sentence and a day of the week. Which sign texts in riddles?

nsge06.title: Pittsburgh: which bridge?
nsge06.caption: Libra can't pick a bridge in the city of bridges. The trick: take the one with someone kind (and a pierogi) on the other side. Which sign needs the longest to decide?

nsge07.title: Anchorage: the long-night stare
nsge07.caption: Scorpio treats the long winter nights like a staring contest, and the moose is winning. Turns out being seen beats being mysterious. Who's the most intense sign in your group?

nsge08.title: Vancouver: the snow globe that rains
nsge08.caption: Taurus shook the snow globe and got rain, which feels very on brand for this city. Half an umbrella later, soup counts as a date. Who's your rainy-day sign?

nsge09.title: Milwaukee: the frozen photo shoot
nsge09.caption: Leo posed on the frozen lake so long the smile froze in place. The one worth meeting asked what Leo actually likes. Which sign has a good side they defend?

nsge10.title: Ottawa: skating to work
nsge10.caption: Capricorn skates to work on schedule every day, right past the same cute face. Slowing down is allowed, Capricorn. Which sign would pencil in a crush?

nsge11.title: Calgary: the chinook crush
nsge11.caption: Aquarius was not ready for a warm wind in the middle of winter, or for feelings. Some things thaw fast. Which sign gets the weirdest when they like someone?

nsge12.title: Winnipeg: tears that sparkle
nsge12.caption: It's so cold here that Pisces' tears come out as glitter, and honestly it's a look. A spare mitten helps too. Which sign cries at the first snowfall?

nsge13.title: Quebec City: two walls, one gate
nsge13.caption: Cancer and Capricorn found a whole city built like them: walls everywhere. Then the maple taffy came out and one gate opened. Which two signs need this trip?

nsge14.title: Salt Lake City: across the widest street
nsge14.caption: Gemini and Sagittarius are opposite signs, and here they're also on opposite sides of a very wide street. Good news: there's a crosswalk. Who are you yelling across the street to?
